description: The image displays three pie charts illustrating categorical distributions related to reasoning-driven text-to-image generation. The rightmost chart, titled “Disjunctive & Conjunctive,” is split into two nearly equal parts: “Disjunctive” (49.51%, light blue) and “Conjunctive” (50.49%, light pink). Each chart includes percentage labels inside its respective slices, and no slices are visually emphasized or exploded. The charts appear to be ordered by descending size within each individual chart.
